title: SAUDI QUAGMIRE: The War MBS Can't Win
author: Ryan Grim
content:
Yemen's war has reached Riyadh. Ansar Allah has repeatedly struck the Saudi
capital's main airport in the past week, killing 13 people in the deadliest
attack on Saudi soil in over a decade, while Saudi jets pound northern Yemen
and the ground offensive Riyadh backs stalls. Ryan Grim talks with Dr. Shireen
Al-Adeimi, a Yemeni-American scholar at Michigan State University, and Dr.
Annelle Sheline of the Quincy Institute, a former State Department official
who resigned over US support for the genocide in Gaza. They discuss how Ansar
Allah turned an 11-year war back on Saudi Arabia, a century of Saudi meddling
in Yemen, why MBS is unwilling to walk away, what the war means for Vision
2030, Yemen's north-south divide, the myth of Ansar Allah as an Iranian proxy,
and whether Trump will join the fight.
